measurement: ET-8 item 4 — mechanisms A and C against baseline, 7B, 80 tasks each
sampling: four DISJOINT 20-task slices of tasks/v1 (1-20, 21-40, 41-60, 61-80). Greedy decode, no seed argument — a re-run is byte-identical, so slices are how independence is obtained. They are slices, NOT sampling seeds.

steering.vectors: experience/vectors/v1_7b, built from base_v1_7b (2,000 decision prompts, tau+ 1761 / tau- 239)
steering.note: the first C run used the 3B artifact (2048-dim) against a 7B model (3584) and produced ZERO episodes. The held-out check is per-MODEL and skipping it for the 7B is what let a shape error reach a run.

paired_by_slice_C_minus_baseline.reading: Slices are identical task sets across arms, so pairing is the right comparison. C is down on green in 3 of 4 slices (mean -2.25/20) and down on localization in 2 of 4 (mean -1.50/20). It does not improve either.

CORRECTION_to_my_own_10817: At 10817 I reported slice 1 alone and said steering IMPROVES localization (18/20 vs 16/20) while not improving green — presenting it as a clean separation of the two deficits. WITH ALL FOUR SLICES THAT IS GONE: localization 81.2% vs the baseline's 88.8%, down in 2 of 4 paired slices. The slice-1 gap was 2 episodes and it did not survive. I published a direction from n=20 after writing in the same block that it needed the other three slices — the caveat was right and I should not have led with the claim.
what_stands: Mechanism A is destructive and large: 20.0% green against 62.5%, 3.2x the input tokens, and the WORST localization of the three arms (47.5%). Consistent across all four slices.
Mechanism C is not an improvement on either axis at alpha=4.0 on this task set. It is much closer to baseline than A is, and its cost is small (7.2 actions vs 6.6, 15.4s vs 18.6s).

The LOCALIZED-BUT-FAILED column is real and roughly constant across arms (21 · 22 · 19 of 80): about a quarter of episodes find the right region and still cannot write the fix. That is the repair floor, and no mechanism here moves it.
not_claimed: That steering cannot work. ONE alpha (4.0), one layer set (9/18/27), decision-token only. The vectors separate held-out states at d' 3.1-4.9, so the PROBE is good and the INTERVENTION is what is untuned.
A mechanism for A's damage beyond the measured noop_patch rise (231 -> 532 steps).
Anything about mechanism F — still undefined in the proposal and the code.
bounds: 80 tasks per arm. Between-slice spread: baseline 15pp, memA 30pp, steerC 30pp.
Greedy, one budget, one model, one memory artifact, one steering configuration.
